description: This Java class defines a final class `DeleteAclEntryStrategy` that handles the command `DeleteAclEntry` for deleting an ACL entry from a Thing respectively managed entity. It extends an abstract strategy class, applies deletion logic, validates ACL modifications, and generates corresponding result and event objects.

classes.name: DeleteAclEntryStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles deletion of an ACL entry on a Thing entity, validating the request, updating ACL, and generating events/results.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the strategy to delete an ACL entry, returning a result indicating success or failure.

methods.name: extractAcl
methods.description: Extracts the Access Control List from the Thing entity if present and authorized.

methods.name: getDeleteAclEntryResult
methods.description: Performs deletion of the ACL entry and constructs the resulting event and response.

methods.name: getAclValidator
methods.description: Creates a validator to ensure ACL integrity after modification.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the previous entity tag for concurrency control.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns an empty optional, indicating no specific entity tag after update.
